newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends at highs in thin dealings.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends at highs in thin dealings.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed a thinly-traded session firmer and just under the day's highs on mixed buying.
The action lifted the market towards resistance seen at 11.00 in March, floor sources said.
The most-active contract climbed 0.11 higher on the day to 10.89, having ranged from 10.90 to 10.75. The back months settled 0.02 lower to 0.12 higher.
Dealings were thin as players remained cautious and prices dwindled in their recent trading range.

"I don't think anyone wants to buy or sell," a broker said. He said potential sellers are hoping the funds will cover their short positions, and buyers are waiting for prices to fall closer to the recent low of 10.60.
Open interest in the March contract remains high at 85,159 lots, off 348 lots.

Contributing to today's gains was evidence of new business in the sugar freight market. Shipbrokers said inquiries boosted by Middle East buying tenders and Brazil deliveries against the October contract.
"There is good support underneath the market related to offtake overnight," the broker said.
Nearby support basis the most-active March contract was maintained at the recent low of 10.60, made Sept 27.
